Terrible experience for the price!
Aug 2026 • Couples
Terrible experience for the price!

I made a reservation one day in advance. Initially, I called the hotline but no one answered. Then I made a reservation via Facebook message and received confirmation. Because I wasn't sure if this was an automated message, I called back to confirm but no one answered. Fortunately, when I called the number +84 91 1206268, someone answered and confirmed the reservation for me.

Because I thought the restaurant operated through Facebook Messenger, I continued to message asking for the menu. I think the seafood can change daily, so I wanted to ask beforehand. However, the message was not replied to.

Then I checked the menu on the fanpage attached to the website and messaged asking very clearly:

"Besides the lobster, is the rest of the menu the same?"

Just about 2 minutes later, the restaurant replied:

"CORRECT."

And this is the biggest problem of that experience.

I went to the restaurant with great anticipation. But when I look at the production line, all I see are the items in the pictures I put below.

I asked the staff directly:
Where are the dishes on the menu? If it's not the case in reality, why didn't the restaurant inform me when I messaged to ask?

Staff also frankly shared that the departments work differently and in this case, the restaurant handled it incorrectly. Since you said the restaurant has an internal menu, then forwarding the actual menu to the customer when they ask is completely possible. I am not asking for anything complicated, I am just confirming exactly what I will be served before deciding to come eat.

More remarkably, I opened the menu on the website and asked for the Lasagna, which was in the very first position on the menu, where. A while later, when I started to complain, the staff brought the dish out and said the kitchen had just refilled it.

But at that time I was at the restaurant, getting food and walking around the line for quite a long time.

Then the staff informed that the manager had left early and requested a 10% discount on the bill.

I also said very clearly that I am not complaining to get a discount.

10% does not solve the problem I am reporting.

What I am dissatisfied with is that the restaurant confirmed to me that the menu was the same, but when I arrived, it was completely different. If the restaurant clearly stated from the beginning that the menu for that day was incomplete or had changes, I have the absolute right to decide whether or not to come.

I even told the staff that:
"It's better to separate and charge extra for special items than to put lobster on the menu and have the rest of the dishes of that quality."

Especially in Nha Trang, where I had high expectations for the quality of seafood, this experience was truly disappointing. Personally, I find the seafood is not as good as some other buffet restaurants, and the price is not the same—but the overall experience and quality are much better.

After talking with the staff, I tried one more round hoping there might be more items to fill up. But in reality, there is nothing different from the beginning.

And speaking specifically about mint ice cream:

I have never eaten a mint ice cream with such a taste. It feels like eating a spoonful of Phat Linh medicated oil. The sourness is so strong that even 10 minutes after eating, there is still a sour feeling in the mouth.

When paying, the staff also gave me a paper form and asked me to rate it. I can only say:

"It's so bad I don't want to rate it."

I don't expect every dish to be perfect. But at such a price, I expect the information provided to the customer to be accurate and the actual experience to match what the restaurant advertises.

This is a very disappointing experience and I will definitely not come back.

Anw, thank you Joyce for taking care of my table last night. You are cute and enthusiastic.

Nhà hàng cũng chân thành ghi nhận những phản hồi của chị về chất lượng cũng như sự đa dạng của các món ăn. Ngon Gallery hiểu rằng đây là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất tạo nên trải nghiệm buffet và giá trị mà khách hàng mong đợi.

Ngon Gallery ghi nhận góp ý này và sẽ lưu ý hơn trong việc kiểm soát tốc độ bổ sung món trong những thời điểm đông khách.

Những chia sẻ của chị về kem bạc hà cũng như chất lượng tổng thể của các món ăn cũng đã được nhà hàng ghi nhận và sẽ được trao đổi trực tiếp với đội ngũ bếp để xem xét, điều chỉnh và cải thiện trong thời gian tới.

Những lời động viên của chị chắc chắn sẽ là nguồn khích lệ rất lớn đối với Joyce và cũng là động lực để đội ngũ tiếp tục cố gắng mang đến những trải nghiệm tốt hơn cho khách hàng. ❤️

Một lần nữa, cảm ơn chị Hương vì những góp ý chân thành và mang tính xây dựng. Ngon Gallery thực sự trân trọng những chia sẻ của chị và rất vui vì từ phản hồi này, nhà hàng đã có thể nhanh chóng khắc phục vấn đề liên quan đến kênh liên lạc mà chị gặp phải.

Ngon Gallery rất mong sẽ có cơ hội được một lần nữa đón tiếp chị Hương, để có thể trực tiếp mang đến cho chị một trải nghiệm tốt đẹp, chỉn chu và trọn vẹn hơn trong lần trở lại. ❤️

All of the dishes were beautifully presented and regularly replenished, ensuring everything stayed fresh. The sushi bar was particularly impressive, with skilled chefs preparing rolls right in front of guests. Beyond seafood, there were also beaf steak, international cuisines ( Korean, Japanies , European... ) and an array of desserts that rounded out the meal perfectly. The atmosphere was comfortable, and the staffs were professional. Although the price was on the higher side, the quality and variety made it absolutely worth it.
